name: Azure VMs
description: Microsoft Azure's B-series are burstable, cost-efficient virtual machines for workloads that don't need full CPU power all the time. We implemented an NVIDIA CUDA module for the B-family Windows machines, so CUDA-based workloads can run on this lower-cost tier.

name: Office365 Administration
description: Under a long-term contract through our EU-registered company, we worked inside a large Microsoft team to redevelop the Office Agenda system for Microsoft 365 administration, with direct support from the DevExpress team on the UI components behind it.

name: Vehicle Marketplace
description: mobile.de is Germany's largest vehicle marketplace for new and used cars, motorhomes, motorcycles and commercial vehicles. Buyers search millions of listings by make, model, price, mileage and location, and dealers and private sellers reach them from a single platform.

name: ETL Plugin
description: A GPU-accelerated bulk processor built on PostgreSQL, with import pipelines that move data from around 20 different relational databases into Postgres at high speed. The work was accepted by a Google development team, which whitelisted us as official contributors.

name: USPS Gateway
description: Integration with the USPS Business Customer Gateway, the Postal Service's single portal for business mailers and shippers. It covers access to USPS mailing and shipping services, returns and Informed Visibility tracking for letters, flats, bundles and containers.

name: PAYONE Clearing
description: PAYONE is a European payment provider for online, in-store and omnichannel payments. Building on bs-payone, our open-source .NET client for its merchant interface, Microsoft quickly signed a contract and integrated PAYONE for all of its payments across the EU.

name: Freecash Blockchain
description: Freecash is a rewards platform trusted by more than 80 million users, who earn real cash for playing games, completing surveys, trying apps and finishing small tasks. Earnings are withdrawn through PayPal, gift cards such as Amazon, and cryptocurrency payouts.

name: CME Risk-Management
description: In CME Group's risk management module, we integrated Clearing House and Clicker services into SPAN/margin trading systems, then reworked them to prevent phishing. The core is written in C++ and driven from Java, with regional SFTP sync keeping CSV data current.

name: Database Management
description: Official GitHub contributors to MonetDB, the open-source column-store database built for high-performance analytics with standard SQL. Around 2015 we created a database management tool for administering MonetDB servers, and we have kept maintaining it ever since.

name: Eppli Auction/Jewelry
description: Eppli is a sworn auction house, jeweller and pawnbroker in Germany with over 40 years of experience. Its platform covers online and judicial auctions, an online shop for jewelry, watches, art and coins, and certificates of authenticity from its own expert center.

name: Ministries of Uzbekistan
description: For nearly five years we worked as consultants, engineers and team leads alongside the technical teams of Uzbekistan's ministries and agencies of Tax, Customs, Transport, Health, Water, Finance, Higher Education, Foreign Affairs and Internal Affairs.

name: Pivot Table
description: Together with the NReco team behind SeekTable, we built petabyte-scale big data analysis with a live-chart system, then reworked the OLAP cube on in-memory key/value storage to deliver CMS reporting for French foreign-affairs and closed audit organizations.

name: National Library
description: Together with the library's team, we built the digital archive and integrated search for the National Library of Uzbekistan named after Alisher Navoi, along with a CRM for readers and services and full automation of the library's administrative work.

name: Reaxys Analyst
description: Reaxys is Elsevier's chemistry intelligence platform, combining curated reaction and substance data with AI for small-molecule discovery. We built clinical analysis on top of ScienceDirect and Scopus, Elsevier's research literature and citation databases.

name: Smart-HRM Axiata
description: Smart Axiata is Cambodia's leading mobile operator, serving millions of subscribers with mobile plans, 5G data, home internet and digital services. We built Smart-HRM, its human resources management system for running employee records and HR processes across the company.

name: UzEx Platforms
description: UzEx is Uzbekistan's Republican Commodity Exchange, running electronic commodity trading, public procurement and a national logistics portal. We built parts of its platforms and published .NET libraries from that work, including Oracle data access via Dapper and MinIO storage clients.

name: 1C Uzbekistan
description: We analyzed the 1C system in the data center that serves 50,000+ organizations across Uzbekistan, optimized its high-load Database and Webservice layer, and introduced a new load-balanced API on top of it. On that API we launched a mobile and tablet cabinet for its users.

name: Microsoft Repository
description: Over 15+ years and 50+ organizations, we have built and reworked more than 10 open-source .NET libraries. They range from high-speed database bulk loaders and ORM extensions with migrations to storage clients and a cross-platform obfuscator for .NET assemblies.

name: OpenBank Crypto
description: After studying BTCPay Server, our team members fluent in Ripple (XRP) helped bring Stellar (XLM) into the Open Bank Project. Following negotiations with its tech team in Frankfurt, Germany, we rolled out our own crypto module for banks on the platform.

name: Loglig Basketball
description: Loglig is an integrated social app for sports management, built for federations, associations and leagues — basketball first among them. Its goal is a more participatory experience for every member, with features, plans and registration in Hebrew and English.

name: Property Management
description: In partnership with BirchStreet, we studied the property and inventory systems of Trump Tower New York and about ten hotels around it, then launched a large project that resolved their gaps with one connected platform for property and inventory management.

name: Data Extraction
description: For Easy Data Feed, we pulled product and order data from 50+ leading e-commerce platforms onto a single server, sorted and normalized it through SFTP and CSV feeds, and loaded it into one central system — giving the business a working foundation for its sales.

name: DSN Tools
description: DSN Tools helps French companies explore, check and aggregate their DSN payroll declarations across multiple periods, with custom extracts, data validation and ready-made HR reports. A five-year partnership: the co-founder says we went past the brief consistently.

name: Identity & Access Management
description: Since 2017, through our company DOTNET.UZ, we have advised on and deployed Keycloak for organizations from government bodies to banks on an outsourcing basis — chosen knowing MyID's limitations and that it is not a pure single sign-on (SSO) system.

name: Ping Exchange
description: Ping is a hybrid crypto exchange that combines blockchain with a uniquely secure login through CorePass, which manages each user's identity and access. It was the first exchange to offer Core Coin (XCB) and Core Token (CTN), with trading, markets and a help center.

name: TADI FacePay
description: TADI (TAD Industries) builds biometric and AI solutions in Uzbekistan. Alongside FacePay, which lets shoppers pay at the till with their face, we rolled out face-ID systems for C/B, airports, stations, the traffic police (GAI) and GSI/GSP.

name: Energy Trucking
description: Energy Trucking is a US carrier running routes across all 48 states. We connected its operations to the services a fleet depends on: fuel cards, City Fuel, Samsara telematics and EFS payments, plus FMCSA (U.S. DOT) carrier data for compliance and safety checks.

name: QuickManage Modules
description: QuickManage is an all-in-one transport management system for fleet, document and expense management. We helped build the first version of its customer cabinet and mobile app, and moved the project forward on the infrastructure side.

name: CSMarketCap Skins
description: CSMarketCap tracks CS2 skin prices across 20+ marketplaces in real time, so traders can compare offers and see market capitalization, trending and falling skins. It adds a trade-up calculator, an inventory checker and live analytics for the whole in-game economy.

name: 0Chain Storage
description: 0Chain is a high-performance datahub on a zero-knowledge network: breach-proof, S3-compatible storage with ACID integrity for backups, data lakes and AI workloads. It is built to cut database, security, API and egress costs compared with traditional cloud storage.

name: Trading Platform
description: TrueDEX is a private, order-book trading platform with its data center in New York and its traders in Moscow, built natively on newer protocols such as MProto and gRPC. We delivered the trading dashboard and an open API for private spot-market trading.

name: Mood Swings
description: For Mood Swings, a fashion label with its own factory in Dubai and a shop in the EU, we built the complete e-commerce online store: limited, carefully curated collections sold across Europe in local currencies and languages, all from one storefront.

name: RickSocial Rental
description: A peer-to-peer rental platform for tools and equipment: owners earn from items that would otherwise sit idle, and renters pay a fraction of the purchase price. Payments run through Stripe, every booking includes damage coverage, and rentals are managed in iOS and Android apps.

name: Terminal API
description: A cloud HRMS where face-recognition terminals (Hikvision SDK) track working time and calculate payroll automatically, while two AI assistants answer 30+ kinds of HR and accounting questions in Uzbek, Russian or English. Used by 20+ organizations and 5,000+ employees.

name: PC Monitoring
description: Attendance and work-time tracking for Windows PCs, built on Windows events instead of manual check-ins: daily app-usage reports with Excel export, screenshots every 15 seconds and remote control from the dashboard. Scales to 100,000 PCs, from $3 per computer a month.

name: VPN Tool
description: A private VPN for Windows, macOS and Android. Traffic is encrypted end to end through a private relay, every session is verified so only approved accounts stay connected, and there is nothing to configure and no admin rights needed — just sign in and press Start.
